requirementSections.heading: Foundation Courses

rules.commentRaw: Select 9 credits chosen from Lists II and III; at least 3 credits must be at the 400 level; students must take at least 3 credits from each list:
List II: Courses on Women, Gender, and Sexuality
List III: Courses on Race, Ethnicity, and Religion
